question: If in a coding system CHARITY is coded as 107 and DAYTIME is coded as 114, then how will PENALIZE be coded in the same coding system?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] The logic followed here is: **Sum of the opposite alphabets place value + 2 = number.** • CHARITY is coded as 107
